fields.summary: Show technician certification status on dispatch board
fields.description:
## Requirements

- On the dispatch board, each technician card should show a badge indicating their certification status: valid, expiring soon (within 30 days), or expired
- Certification data lives in the `certifications` subproject; the dispatch board is in the `scheduling` subproject
- The badge should be color-coded: green for valid, yellow for expiring, red for expired
- If a technician has multiple certifications, show the worst status (i.e., if any cert is expired, show expired)
